requirements.statement: Shoppers can browse the catalog of handmade ceramic pieces

criteria.must: The catalog page lists available products
Each listed product shows its title, price, and a photo

requirements.statement: Shoppers can view a product's detail page with photos, description, price, and availability

criteria.must: Opening a product from the catalog shows its detail page
The detail page shows photos, description, price, and availability status

requirements.statement: Shoppers can search and filter the catalog

criteria.must: Searching by keyword returns only matching products
Filtering by category returns only products in that category

requirements.statement: Shoppers can add a piece to their cart

criteria.must: Adding a product to the cart increases the cart's item count
An already-sold product cannot be added to the cart

requirements.statement: Shoppers can review and adjust their cart before checkout

criteria.must: The cart page lists every added item with its price
Removing an item from the cart updates the displayed total

requirements.statement: Shoppers can check out as a guest with shipping and payment details

criteria.must: A shopper with no account can complete checkout by entering shipping and payment details
Checkout charges the card via the payment provider before the order is placed

requirements.statement: Shoppers can sign in to save their details and view order history

criteria.must: A shopper can sign in via the store's sign-in flow

requirements.statement: Shoppers receive an order confirmation after checkout

criteria.must: After placing an order the shopper sees an order confirmation with an order reference
The order confirmation message is clear about what happens next

requirements.statement: Signed-in shoppers can view their order history

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper's order history lists their past orders with status
A shopper cannot see another shopper's orders in their order history

requirements.statement: The Store Admin can sign in to an admin area restricted to authorized staff

criteria.must: Signing in as the Store Admin grants access to the admin area
A signed-in shopper without the admin role is denied access to the admin area

requirements.statement: The Store Admin can create, edit, and remove product listings

criteria.must: The Store Admin can create a new product listing
The Store Admin can edit an existing product listing
The Store Admin can remove a product listing

requirements.statement: A piece is automatically marked sold and removed from the catalog once purchased

criteria.must: After a successful checkout the purchased product's status becomes sold
A sold product no longer appears in the browsable catalog

requirements.statement: The Store Admin can view incoming orders with shopper and shipping details

criteria.must: The admin orders view lists incoming orders
Opening an order shows its shipping details

requirements.statement: The Store Admin can update an order's fulfillment status

criteria.must: The Store Admin can change an order's status (e.g. to packed, shipped, delivered)
The updated status is reflected when the order is viewed again
